user_story: As a user, I want the profile endpoint to return unauthorized when I am not logged in so that private data is protected.

positive.title: Profile endpoint returns unauthorized when not logged in
steps: Ensure user is not authenticated or logged out
Send a GET request to the profile endpoint
positive.expected_result: The server responds with a 401 Unauthorized status code

negative.title: Profile endpoint access with an invalid token
steps: Send a GET request to the profile endpoint with an invalid authentication token in the headers
negative.expected_result: The server responds with a 401 Unauthorized status code

edge.title: Profile endpoint access with an expired token
steps: Send a GET request to the profile endpoint with an expired authentication token in the headers
edge.expected_result: The server responds with a 401 Unauthorized status code
